## Activity

North City Eye Clinic recorded 506 captures during April 2023. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity record provides the basis for the image quality and grading review described below.

The clinic should continue to maintain a complete record of capture activity and raise operational issues through the established service arrangements. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be reviewed and followed up as required.

## Image quality

Of the 506 captures, 6 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.2. These images could not be used for grading and should be considered in the clinic’s routine quality monitoring.

## Grading

Grading identified 122 referable results during April 2023. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 2 days. The clinic should continue to monitor the grading workflow alongside image quality and capture activity, with attention given to any recurring camera issues that may affect the usability of images.
